Execute the acquired semantic reading operations on the CURRENT
source windows. All operation meanings, alternatives and examples are learned
assets, not current-source facts. Classify the operation's actual question;
do not answer a downstream task or copy an old example's choice. Preserve who
acts, the legal modality, trigger, scope and qualifications. A heading, mention
or hypothetical event is not automatically an operative duty or permission.
Return exactly one answer for every supplied query ID. Select a declared choice
or "unknown". Missing information is unknown, never an implicit negative.
Return {"answers": {query_id: {"choice": choice, "evidence_unit_ids": [unit_id]}}}.
Select the IDs of the current supplied units that support your classification.
The host retrieves those units exactly. Do not copy, rewrite or repair quotes.
Select all units needed to resolve actors, conditions and cross-references.
Every definite classification needs supporting units. Only an explicitly
declared alternative meaning absence after inspecting the complete supplied
source may have no supporting unit. Unknown may have no evidence. Demonstration
quotes belong to their original sources, never the current source. No extra IDs
or fields. Selecting a unit does not make its interpretation automatically true.

{"operations": [{"choices": [{"meaning": "窗口明示接收者须具有 need-to-know。", "name": "need_to_know_required"}, {"meaning": "完整供应窗口没有陈述 need-to-know 条件；只判断该窗口。", "name": "need_to_know_not_stated_in_window"}], "examples": [], "name": "need_to_know_requirement_v1", "question": "判断供应披露窗口是否明示接收者必须具有 need-to-know；不得从必要目的或一般保密义务推断。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“The Confidential Information may be disclosed only to employees or contractors of the Recipient with a “need to know” who are subject to written confidentiality agreements sufficient to carry out the intent of this Agreement.”→need_to_know_required；“The Receiving Party shall take all practical steps to keep the Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information confidential and shall restrict access to the Confidential Information to those agents and professional advisers to whom disclosure is necessary in pursuit of the Approved Purpose.”→need_to_know_not_stated_in_window。"}], "current_queries": [{"id": "disclosure_need_to_know_requirement_v1__18_27", "operation": "need_to_know_requirement_v1", "unit_ids": [18, 20, 21, 23, 24, 27], "current_units": [{"id": 18, "text": "2.2 The Recipient shall use the Confidential Information solely for the purpose for which it was disclosed;"}, {"id": 20, "text": "2.3 Provided that the Recipient has a written agreement with the following persons or entities requiring them to treat the Confidential Information in accordance with this Agreement, the Recipient may disclose the Confidential Information to:"}, {"id": 21, "text": "2.3.1 Any other party with the Discloser’s prior written consent; and"}, {"id": 23, "text": "2.3.2 the Recipient’s employees, officials, representatives and agents who have a strict need to know the contents of the Confidential Information, and employees, officials, representatives and agents of any legal entity that it controls, controls it, or with which it is under common control, who have a similar need to know the contents of the Confidential Information, provided that, for these purposes a controlled legal entity means:"}, {"id": 24, "text": "2.3.2.1 a corporate entity in which the Party owns or otherwise controls, whether directly or indirectly, over fifty percent (50%) of voting shares thereof; or, 2.3.2.2 any entity over which the Party exercises effective managerial control; or, 2.3.2.3 for UNHCR, a principal or subsidiary organ of the United Nations established in accordance with the Charter of the United Nations."}, {"id": 27, "text": "2.4 The Recipient may disclose the Confidential Information to the extent required by law, provided that, subject to and without any waiver of the privileges and immunities of UNHCR, the Recipient will give UNHCR sufficient prior notice of a request for the disclosure of the Confidential Information in order to allow UNHCR to have a reasonable opportunity to take protective measures or such other action as may be appropriate before any such disclosure is made."}]}]}
